The Battle for Ryloth'' |author=[[Zachary Rau]] |cover artist= |illustrator= |editor= |publisher=[[Grosset & Dunlap]] |early release= |release date=[[July 23]], [[2009]]{{PenguinBooks|group=1|url=nf/Book/BookDisplay/0,,9780448452012,00.html|text=The Battle for Ryloth}} |intl release= |rereleased= |media type=Paperback |pages=96 |isbn=9780448452012 |isbn2= |isbn3= |timeline=[[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]{{TCWdates|119}} |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''The Clone Wars: The Battle for Ryloth''''' is a young-reader story based on "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]", "[[Innocents of Ryloth]]," and "[[Liberty on Ryloth]]," episodes from the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. Published by [[Grosset & Dunlap]] in [[2009]], it was adapted by [[Zachary Rau]]. {{Book-stub}} ==Publisher's summary== ''The planet of Ryloth has fallen under siege by Separatist forces. Now Mace Windu must lead the clone army against the evil Separatist Alliance.
